name: WardriveESP for the LilyGO T-Dongle C5
author: Aediliss
description: WardriveESP 1.7.11 with the T-Dongle C5's screen, LED and button: a dashboard on the 0.96" display, the LED lighting up for Wardrive Go alerts, and BOOT for pages and stealth.
notes: If the flasher can't connect, hold BOOT while plugging it in. Rev 1.0: full-chip erase can drop USB; use esptool with --before no-reset and without --erase-all instead of the web flasher. Wardrive Go firmware updates install stock WardriveESP, leaving the screen and LED unused.
